reason: My first thought is that I can just ask ChatGPT for free. I already snap pictures of things and ask an assistant what's in them, so a separate iPhone app that does one narrow job feels like paying for something I can get elsewhere.
objection: Why would I pay $39.99 a year for an app when a free AI assistant can already tell me which dishes are fried or creamy? I'm not sure this app is any more accurate than what I'd get by asking it myself.
would_change_my_mind: Proof that it's clearly more accurate than a general AI assistant on real restaurant menus, for example a side-by-side test showing it catches cream sauces and frying that ChatGPT misses.
